_doc: Plain-English labels for gifts and rewards, applied by scripts/guide_data.py to the NPC text found around each give. First rule whose regex matches (case-insensitive) wins; \1, \2 are filled from groups. Only wording the text itself supports belongs here. Anything unmatched keeps the NPC's own words on the page.
